I’ve been in contact with the fbi’s ic3 department and a company called zero shadow. They provide an in depth investigation and assist law enforcement. 
I’m still at a loss. I can’t comprehend how my machine got compromised. The support team at phantom stated that my pc has interacted with a malicious website and they have blocked the site entirely. I’m sick over this event. I feel absolutely terrible for all of us. We have been working our asses off to make this work and this is a huge kick in the shorts. Right now I feel defeated. I feel my breath has been knocked out of me. 
I promise you i will stand up and continue to work on this project. I will continue to push for success. I will not quit.
